Note: The UPTET 2026 syllabus for both Primary Level (Class 1 to 5) and Junior Level (Class 6 to 8) will be based on the prescribed teacher eligibility curriculum. All questions will be objective type.




UPTET 2026 Exam Duration and Question Format

The total exam duration will be 2 Hours 30 Minutes or 150 Minutes.
The paper will contain 150 objective type multiple choice questions (MCQs).
Each question will carry 1 mark.
The question paper will be available in Hindi and English, except for language subjects.





Important Information

UPTET 2026 Primary Level is for Class 1 to 5 teacher eligibility.
UPTET 2026 Junior Level is for Class 6 to 8 teacher eligibility.
Both papers will contain 150 MCQs carrying 150 marks.
Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
The official notice shown here does not mention negative marking.
Read the official UPTET 2026 notification for complete syllabus and subject-wise details.





														
														




📝 How to Apply UPTET 2026 Online Form




Step 1: Visit Official Website

Visit the official website 
upessc.up.gov.in and open the 
UPTET 2026 notification / application section. Click on the active link for 
UPTET 2026 Online Application Form.





Step 2: Complete Registration

Click on New Registration and enter your basic details such as candidate name, mobile number, email ID, date of birth and other required information. After successful registration, save your Registration Number and Password.





Step 3: Fill Online Application Form

Login using your Registration Number and Password. Fill all required details carefully in the UPTET 2026 application form including personal information, address details, educational qualification, eligibility details, language selection and exam level selection.





Step 4: Select Level and Language

Choose the appropriate exam level according to your eligibility:

• Primary Level (Class I-V)
• Junior Level (Class VI-VIII)
You can also select the available language from Hindi, English, Sanskrit or Urdu.





Step 5: Upload Required Documents

Upload scanned copies of required documents in the prescribed format such as:

• Recent Passport Size Photograph
• Signature
• Educational Certificates / Marksheet
• Category Certificate (if applicable)
• Other supporting documents if required





Step 6: Pay Application Fee

Pay the application fee through online mode using Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, SBI Collect, SBI E-Challan or other available payment options.





Step 7: Final Submit and Print Form

Preview the complete UPTET 2026 Online Form carefully before final submission. After successful submission, download and print the confirmation page / submitted application form for future use.
